user.description: Sign in with the account you use for the Kermi X-Center portal ({portal}).

reauth_confirm.description: The Kermi portal rejected the stored credentials for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: The email address or password is incorrect.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Kermi portal.

abort.already_configured: This Kermi account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often datapoint values are read from the portal. Lower values update faster but make more cloud requests.
data_description.language: Language for entity and state names. The Kermi portal only translates these into a few languages; anything else falls back to German. Changing this re-scans the datapoints on the next reload.

rediscover.name: Rediscover datapoints
rediscover.description: Re-scans a Kermi X-Center installation for datapoints that have appeared since setup. Additive only - existing entities are never changed or removed.

config_entry_id.name: Installation
config_entry_id.description: The Kermi X-Center installation to re-scan. Leave empty to re-scan every configured installation.

entry_not_found.message: The selected entry was not found or is not a Kermi X-Center installation.
